description:
Cast Blood Tribute with kicker by paying {4}{B}{B} and tapping Vito, causing an opponent to lose half their life total rounded up and you to gain the much life.
Vito triggers, causing the opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

uses.name: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose
